title.narrative: BID CLIMA: Programa de fortalecimiento de las trayectorias educativas y la resiliencia climática del sistema escolar salvadoreño
IDB CLIMA: Program for Strengthening Educational trajectories and Climate Resilience of the Salvadoran School System

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es consolidar trayectorias educativas completas y fortalecer la resiliencia climática del sistema escolar, para así generar capacidades en el país para acceder a mercados de deuda verde. Los objetivos específicos son: (i) Incrementar la oferta educativa con resiliencia al CC y énfasis en los niveles de parvularia y secundaria; (ii) incrementar los servicios de protección de trayectorias incluyendo población migrante; (iii) fortalecer los servicios educativos para la inclusión de las PcD; y (iv) fortalecer las capacidades de gestión educativa, incluyendo la identificación, diseño y ejecución de proyectos que integren medidas de resiliencia frente al CC, además de las capacidades de monitoreo y reporte de impacto.

The objective of the program is to consolidate educational paths and strengthen the climate resilience of the country's educational system to develop the needed capacities to access green thematic debt markets. Specific objectives include: (i) an increase of coverage in education with an emphasis on climate resilience in primary and secondary education levels; (ii) an increase in educational pathways protection, including amongst migrants; (iii) an increase to educational services for disabled populations; and (iv) the strengthening of management and capacities within the relevant sectors to improve education services, as well as the identification, design and execution of projects that integrate climate resilience as well as the systems and infrastructure needed to report impact tied to climate monitoring, reporting and verification systems.
